hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS"; case "$FILE" in *.swift) if command -v swiftformat >/dev/null 2>&1; then swiftformat "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; else echo "swiftformat: skipped (not installed)"; fi; if command -v swiftlint >/dev/null 2>&1; then swiftlint --fix --quiet "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi ;; esac'

bash -c 'CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_command"; case "$CMD" in *"git commit"*) if [ ! -f Package.swift ] && ! ls *.xcodeproj >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! ls *.xcworkspace >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "no Package.swift / .xcodeproj / .xcworkspace at repo root (likely a KMM repo); skipping ios pre-commit"; else if command -v swiftlint >/dev/null 2>&1; then swiftlint --quiet --strict || { echo "swiftlint failed; commit blocked"; exit 1; }; else echo "swiftlint: skipped (not installed)"; fi; if [ -f Package.swift ]; then swift build 2>&1 | tail -20 || { echo "swift build failed; commit blocked"; exit 1; }; fi; fi ;; esac'
